title: 还可以更好 · We Could Do Better
description: 车窗外的城市已经修好了。阿登却想起汉娜说过的话：英雄救了人以后，还要看什么？

sources.title: Super Supportive — Sleyca
sources.note: User-supplied EPUB, FIVE: The Nice One, city repairs through Hannah’s explanation of complementary support. Stops before Jeremy nudges Alden. Simplified Mandarin adaptation; Skiff’s motives remain Alden’s inference.

planning.sourceBoundary: Outside the window, buildings raced past. → before Suddenly, a flip-flop nudged Alden’s shin.
planning.dramaticChange: At eleven Alden rejects Hannah’s sad motto; at sixteen he sees why a successful hero may need help and why support can multiply strength.
planning.englishNarrationPurpose: None; first-person Mandarin with a source-grounded remembered conversation.
choicesAndCallbacks: Notice the repaired home or news: different thought, rejoin Skiff.
Ask whether the motto is sad or who it is for: different Hannah response, rejoin private guideline.
Ask about effort or looking at errors: different response, rejoin her support motive.
Consider helping speed or distance: distinct possible support roles; rejoin sidekick danger.
sceneActivities: Alden sits on the train, watching passing buildings; a remembered seated meal with Hannah interrupts the present. Shared restaurant setting and supported seated rests; food actions are narrated, not claimed as animated handoffs.
planning.voiceReason: A remembered ordinary meal changes how Alden understands a missing mentor and another hero’s strained smile.
planning.desire: Understand what Hannah meant and why a hero can save people yet look unhappy.
planning.obstacle: The public success story hides emotional costs; Alden’s younger idea of heroism was simpler.
planning.earlyCare: He sees his old neighborhood looking repaired while knowing its losses are not erased.
planning.payoff: Hannah’s seemingly sad motto becomes a practical commitment to look at mistakes and help others.
planning.newUncertainty: Could support change what heroes must do to win, despite the danger to their helpers?
planning.directing: Present solo listener frame → remembered two-shot → Hannah’s choice to examine mistakes → young Alden listener and held observation → shared framing → present-day realization. Final remembered line returns to shared pair before present Alden’s interpretation.

signatures.Alden: At sixteen, careful inferences and modest correction of his own argument; at eleven, direct literal objections and concrete questions.
signatures.Hannah: Warm, self-questioning explanations; casual food pause while naming difficult consequences, then genuine enthusiasm for support.

teaser.speaker: Hannah
teaser.line: We could have done that better.
teaser.scene: Hannah and eleven-year-old Alden at a table during his first island visit; she offers her changed heroic motto.
teaser.style: Expressive oil pastel with luminous cobalt shadows and warm peach highlights

limitations: The youngest supported teen body approximates eleven-year-old Alden; the narration establishes his age explicitly.
Skiff’s pursuit is described from news and inference; no new scene depicts unverified motive.
planning.pinyinReview: Reviewed 58 complete lines and all chunks. Corrected complement/potential de, lexical neutral syllables (window, news, brain, eyes, things, places, time), experiential guo, reduplication and sentence/chunk discrepancies. Verified chongxin, zhuanqian, caomei, naixi, shu, zhi and hai in context.

continuation.end: After replaying the messages, Alden sees the repaired city and recalls Hannah’s changed heroic motto. At eleven he found it sad; now he considers Skiff’s emotional burden and why complementary support could change a fight. Hannah’s absence remains unresolved.
continuation.nextStart: Suddenly, a flip-flop nudged Alden’s shin.
continuation.note: Jeremy brings Alden back to the train stop; friends argue about who is nice, mean or funny, and Jeremy unexpectedly identifies Alden’s persistent wish to be a superhero. End at the chapter’s closing conversation, before the author note.
continuity: Alden is sixteen on the train; the eleven-year-old island conversation was a memory.
Hannah has been missing six months; her death remains unconfirmed.
Alden suspects Skiff’s strained smile reflects the cost of drowning the villain; this is not confirmed.
Hannah chose support abilities despite their risks and believed complementary heroes could multiply each other’s effectiveness.
Jeremy is about to nudge Alden because they have reached their stop.

contains: 这只是我的想法。可那个坏人停下来的地方是大路上，不是在水里。
有一段时间，他们真的遇到能力很强的坏人，活下来的，只有百分之十二。
routes.endsWith: 我看外面的房子。她说的“更好”，不只是再多救一个人。也可能是，让另外一个人不用什么都自己做。

contains: 不一定。我想，这更像是对我自己说的话。
那就不是两个人加起来那么简单了。你们一起能做到的，会比两个人分开做，多得多！

reviewTargets: 所以，我想做那个愿意去看的人。这样，下次也许就能少做错一些事。
我不再喝东西了。她不是在说怎么让大家喜欢她。
我看外面的房子。她说的“更好”，不只是再多救一个人。也可能是，让另外一个人不用什么都自己做。
